notes.text: Rabbi Zerika explicitly reports the visit with Rabbi Yannai son of Rabbi Ammi. The passage omits the priestly title, which is retained from the heading.
The Bavli supplies Yannai son of Ammi. The Yerushalmi separately supplies Yannai the father-in-law. This namesake explanation is Heilprin’s inference.
The directly cited episode supports the link to Zerika. Heilprin disclaims the basis of the separate Rav Safra chronology, which the cited passage does not give.
